extracted.name: Very easy bread pudding. Use up you´re leftovers
extracted.description: Wanted a simple dessert for no money at all. We call it "bodding" every housewife has here own recipy and you can find it on mondays at the bakery.
ingredient_lines: 100 gr dark chocolat or raisins,currents, peel,..
tin Some butter and flower for your cake
instruction_lines: Warm the milk and dissolve the sugars
Cut the bread into small pieces. I used a cheap white loaf.
Cover the bread with the milk and add the vanilla. Soak for 10 min.
Make a mash from the bead mixture
Add the beaten eggs and the flower. The dough is very wet.
Flower a cake tin and put in the mixture.
Bake for 50 min. The end result is still moist. Cool and slice
